description: Utility class for encoding and decoding specific characters used in resource and ID naming conventions within the Ditto protocol ecosystem. Provides methods for percent-encoding certain special characters to ensure safe transmission and representation in URLs and protocol messages.

classes.name: DittoEncodingHelper
classes.description: A deprecated utility class providing static methods to encode and decode specific characters that require escaping in naming and protocol contexts within Ditto.

methods.name: encode
methods.description: Encodes a string by replacing reserved characters with their percent-encoded equivalents.

methods.name: decode
methods.description: Decodes a percent-encoded string back to its original form by reversing the encoding process.
